label: Shaphan

text.BHSA JER 29:2: אַחֲרֵ֣י צֵ֣את יְכָנְיָֽה־הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְהַגְּבִירָ֨ה וְהַסָּרִיסִ֜ים שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֧ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְהֶחָרָ֥שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֖ר מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
text.KJV JER 29:2: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
text.BHSA JER 29:3: בְּיַד֙ אֶלְעָשָׂ֣ה בֶן־שָׁפָ֔ן וּגְמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּבֶ֥לָה לֵאמֹֽר׃ ס
text.KJV JER 29:3: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
text.BHSA JER 29:4: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֹ֖ות אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְכָל־הַ֨גֹּולָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלֵ֥יתִי מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
text.KJV JER 29:4: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

A.name: Shaphan
A.notes: He was sent to repair the house of the Lord (2CH 34:8)
family: scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)
grandfather-of gedaliah (Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, appointed King of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2K)

B.name: Shaphan
B.line: Father of Elasah, envoy sent by Zedekiah to Babylon.

why: The Hebrew identifies Elasah as בֶן־שָׁפָן, “son of Shaphan,” and places him among Zedekiah’s envoys to Babylon. B explicitly matches this father–son relationship and event; A’s stated facts do not identify him as Elasah’s father.
